entries.en: Fixed: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER environment variable now properly disables package manager update notifications
entries.zh: 修复：`DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER` 环境变量现在能正确禁用包管理器的更新通知

entries.en: Fixed queued messages being incorrectly executed as bash commands
entries.zh: 修复了排队消息被错误地执行为 bash 命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed input being lost when typing while a queued message is processed
entries.zh: 修复了在处理排队消息时键入时丢失输入的问题
